essence: The ritual requires Brahmā on the right and Viṣṇu on the left.
The principal pot must be placed in the head region of Brahmā and Viṣṇu.
Eight pots identified with the Vidyeśvaras must be placed around the arrangement.
Worship with the appropriate forms and states must be performed according to prescription.
The tattvas and related elements must be applied as before for the deity and as stated for Kaviṣṇu.
